description.value: The Flying Whale Café is the in-house café of Flyover, Vancouver's immersive aerial flight simulation attraction anchored at the iconic Canada Place on the downtown waterfront. The café serves a full range of specialty coffee drinks, teas, pastries, hot food items, and alcoholic beverages, with both indoor and outdoor seating. Its location on the Coal Harbour waterfront puts it steps from Stanley Park and Gastown, making it a convenient stop on a downtown Vancouver cycling loop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms The Flying Whale Café is the in-house café of Flyover, an aerial simulation attraction at Canada Place, with a full menu of coffee drinks, hot food, pastries, and alcoholic beverages. OSM tags for indoor_seating and outdoor_seating are corroborated by the café's presence at a major waterfront venue. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content; the menu does explicitly list 'Vegetarian Spring Rolls' confirming at least one vegetarian option.
concerns: Phone number (1-855-463-4822) is absent from OSM tags but present on website; added from website.

It is unclear from the website whether the café is accessible to the general public without purchasing a Flyover attraction ticket — cyclists may be unable to enter without buying entry. No explicit statement either way was found.
OSM address omits the unit number in the formatted string; website confirms full address as 201-999 Canada Place.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café at a major downtown Vancouver tourist destination on the waterfront cycling route. Actively operated with a current menu and recent news coverage through early 2026.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists 'Vegetarian Spring Rolls served with Plum Sauce'; salads and parfait also present. No GF labelling observed
